datadir.description: Directory containing linguistic data files (e.g., modes.xml, .autobil.bin)

format.description: Input/output format: txt (default), html, html-noent, or rtf

unknown_mark.description: Enable marking of unknown words with '*' character (true = enabled; false = -u)

disambig_mark.description: Enable marking of disambiguated words with '=' character

header_detect.description: Enable header-detection (only for language pairs that support it)

language_pairs.description: List of language pairs (e.g., ['es-ca', 'ca-es']) in LANG1-LANG2 format; required for translation to work

input_file.description: Input file path; empty string uses stdin (default)

output_file.description: Output file path; empty string uses stdout (default)

memory_direction.description: Use translation memory direction; true = use 'direction' as lookup key
